title: August's official inflation drops -0.32% – lowest in four years
subtitle: Itaipu Bonus and falling food and transport prices drive deflation
excerpt: Official August inflation closed at -0.32%, the lowest rate in four years, influenced by the Itaipu Bonus and a drop in food and transport prices.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Official inflation for the month of August closed with a negative variation of -0.32%, marking the lowest rate observed in the last four years.

According to the news summary, the combination of the Itaipu Bonus and falling prices for food and transportation were the main factors driving inflation into negative territory.

With this result, the -0.32% rate represents the lowest recorded since August 2022, when the index had also shown similar values.

With information from Agência Brasil.
